guidance.bestFor: The minimal markup: 1 photo at the default size with 2 letter initials kept as the fallback

whenNotToUse.when: A person with no photo on file, shown only by initials or an icon

guidance.bestFor: Photo free placeholders: 2 letter initials and a user icon, both on the muted fallback fill

whenNotToUse.when: Initials that need a tinted color per person rather than the muted gray

guidance.bestFor: The 3 built-in steps of the size prop, sm, default and lg, shown side by side on 1 photo

whenNotToUse.when: Dimensions outside the 3 presets, such as 16 or 64 pixels

guidance.bestFor: Square and soft cornered photos with md, lg and xl radius set next to the default circle
agentNotes: The 3 cornered avatars leave `AvatarFallback` at its round default, so a photo that fails to load shows a circle inside the cornered border

guidance.bestFor: Free sizing through className at 16, 32, 48 and 64 pixels, beyond the 3 presets of the size prop
agentNotes: Sizes set through `className` leave `data-size` at default, so the fallback text and any `AvatarBadge` keep their default size

whenNotToUse.when: Sizes that should scale the badge and fallback text along with the photo

name: c-avatar-6
title: Avatar with an online status badge
label: Status Dots
description: Avatar with an online status badge

guidance.bestFor: Plain presence dots in the default bottom right spot, colored primary, green, yellow and destructive
agentNotes: Each `AvatarBadge` is an empty span whose color alone marks status; map your presence values to its classes and give each a screen reader label

guidance.bestFor: Corner badges holding a plus, check, star or shield icon on primary, success, warning and info fills
agentNotes: `AvatarBadge` hides its icon when the parent `Avatar` has `size` sm, so keep icon badges at default or lg

guidance.bestFor: Round photos with the dot moved to each of the 4 corners, sitting on the edge of the circle
Square photos with the dot pushed 4 pixels past each of the 4 corners
agentNotes: Only `rounded-md` is set, so the border layer of each `Avatar` stays a circle over the square photo; add after:rounded-md as `c-avatar-4` does

guidance.bestFor: A stack of 3 overlapping photos with a background ring and no count chip at the end

whenNotToUse.when: More people than fit in the row, so the hidden rest needs a +N tally

guidance.bestFor: A 3 photo stack closed by a muted chip from the group count part that reads +3
agentNotes: `AvatarGroupCount` holds a typed +3; compute it from your member total minus the photos shown

label: Plus Chip Group
description: Avatar group with an icon count

guidance.bestFor: A 3 photo stack ending in a round plus chip in place of a number
agentNotes: `AvatarGroupCount` renders a plain div, so the plus chip takes no focus or click until you wrap it in a button

guidance.bestFor: A bordered pill with 4 small stacked photos and a bold 100K+ figure in its caption
agentNotes: The caption next to `AvatarGroup` hard-codes Trusted by 100K+ users; bind the figure to a real count before shipping

guidance.bestFor: A Frame panel holding 4 developer photos and a Joined by 500+ developers caption

title: Avatar group with hover tooltips and lift effect
label: Lift Tooltips
description: Avatar group with hover tooltips and lift effect

guidance.bestFor: A hand built overlap where the hovered photo rises 4 pixels with a shadow and a name tooltip
agentNotes: Replace `avatars` with your people; each entry's `name` feeds both the photo `alt` and the tooltip text

guidance.bestFor: A stack that fans apart on hover, each photo sliding by its index and the hovered one growing 10 percent
agentNotes: Swap `avatars` for your people; the spread and `zIndex` both come from each item's `index` in the map, so array order sets the overlap

whenNotToUse.when: Names that should appear on hover over each person

name: c-avatar-24
title: Avatar group with hover effect and tooltips
label: Fan With Tooltips
description: Avatar group with hover effect and tooltips

guidance.bestFor: The fan out hover stack with a name tooltip on each photo, the Avatar itself rendered as the trigger
agentNotes: `TooltipTrigger` hands its role to the `Avatar` span on both twins, and a span takes no keyboard focus, so names show on hover only

whenNotToUse.when: Keyboard users who must reach each name by tabbing to it

guidance.bestFor: A bordered pill of 4 small photos split by background borders, with a plain +3 text tally
agentNotes: The stack skips `AvatarGroup` and its count part, so the +3 is plain text you must compute yourself

whenNotToUse.when: A count chip that matches the photo size and ring, built from the group parts

A solid primary pill button with a thin primary border around the 24 pixel photo at its left

label: Empty State

guidance.bestFor: A no collaborators prompt with 3 grayscale photos, an add person chip and invite copy below
agentNotes: `AvatarGroupCount` carries an aria-label but stays a non focusable div, so wrap it in a button before wiring the invite

label: Group Add Button

guidance.bestFor: A 3 photo stack with a +5 chip beside a round add user button that shows a tooltip
agentNotes: `TooltipTrigger` wraps the `Button` without composing it, so both twins nest a button inside a button; pass it through render or asChild

guidance.bestFor: A spinner over a 60 percent background veil on the photo, switched on and off by a demo timer
agentNotes: `setInterval` flips `loading` every 2 seconds for the demo; drive `loading` from your real request state

whenNotToUse.when: A pulsing placeholder shape held until the photo and name arrive

guidance.bestFor: A blue verified rosette drawn as inline SVG, placed at a different corner on each of 4 large photos
agentNotes: `CustomBadge` is an inline svg with no title or label, so screen readers never hear the verified status

guidance.bestFor: A photo and green offset ring pulsing together, with a green dot drawn as a plain span past the bottom right
agentNotes: `animate-pulse` sits on the `Avatar` root, so the whole photo fades with the ring and keeps pulsing under reduced motion

guidance.bestFor: A story style ring: a blurred yellow to violet gradient spinning behind the photo, brighter on hover
agentNotes: `alt` reads User story rather than a name; pass the person's display name so screen readers say who it is

guidance.bestFor: A presence dot at the bottom right and a red count of 3 at the top right of one photo
agentNotes: The red count is a plain span with a typed 3 beside `AvatarBadge`; bind it to your real count and hide it at zero

guidance.bestFor: A pill trigger with photo, name and up down chevron that opens Profile, Settings, Teams, Invite and Log out
agentNotes: Every `DropdownMenuItem` is a stub with no handler; wire Profile, Settings, Teams, Invite and Log out to your routes
